registered_limitations: ENTRY STYLE (T4 min-raise 35% vs 57.8 / T6 limp 29% vs 63.7, BOTH PROVISIONAL grade): pool is less limpy / min-raise-heavy than the field. SECOND-ORDER for exploitation (small deep pots, postflop-dominated, our noisiest data [B1] lower-bounds / [B2] folds-unseen). Error direction = UNDER-exploitation (RNR-anchor-safe). The §4.4 aggression-inflation caps fence the over-attack-passivity failure mode REGARDLESS of T4/T6 exactness. PROBE READING: if the probe shows aggression inflation, that is THIS GAP BITING and the §4.4 caps need scrutiny — NOT a green light.

POSITIONAL SPREAD / SHAPE (T2_EP,T2_MP,T2_CO,T2_BB): EP 15 / MP 17 / CO 20 / BTN 26 / SB 30 / BB 12 (field 20.8/21.4/26.7/22.7/27.9/9.0; EP->BTN gap +10.8pp vs field +1.9 flat). The coherent Shanky span cannot jointly reproduce the field's open-seat flatness AND its blind/CO levels (position-aware members widen EP->BTN; position-flat members botch the blinds). SECOND-ORDER vs the jam wall; positional read affects steal/defense frequencies. The balanced v1 keeps SB + the jam sub-bands at the cost of a wider open-seat spread.

JAM-WALL FINE-STRUCTURE (T7_15-25,T8_15-25): narrow misses in the 15-50bb jam sub-bands (pool jams marginally less than the field there). The DECISION-GRADE HEADLINE jam metrics (T7_jam_5_15 combined, T5 open-jam share, T7_5-10, T7_10-15) are IN-CI; the high-EV 5-15bb jam wall is intact. LOW EV (1-13% rates, sub-bands within ~1pp of CI).
